levels.label: Pre-A1
levels.description: Absolute beginners, formulaic phrases, basic script and phonology

levels.label: Breakthrough / Beginner
levels.description: Basic survival language, simple everyday sentences and formulaic expressions

levels.label: Waystage / Elementary
levels.description: Routine exchanges, direct information, basic social and daily life contexts

levels.label: Threshold / Intermediate
levels.description: Main points of clear standard input, work, school, travel, and personal interest topics

levels.label: Vantage / Upper Intermediate
levels.description: Complex text, technical discussion, fluent and spontaneous interaction

levels.label: Effective Operational Proficiency / Advanced
levels.description: Wide range of demanding texts, implicit meaning, flexible and nuanced communication

levels.label: Mastery / Proficiency
levels.description: Virtual native-level ease, spontaneous expression, subtle shades of meaning
